description: Rebuilt from verified state. V1 sprints archived. R-018 through R-023 superseded by S0-S10.

sprints.name: Ground Truth UI Inventory — Parallel DOM Crawl + Screenshot Verification
sprints.outcome: Two independent inventories (Playwright DOM crawl + screenshot visual analysis) produced in parallel, then diffed against each other. Mismatches flagged. Coverage calculated.
acceptanceCriteria: U-001.B1: State enumeration lists every route, tab, modal, conditional view, permission gate, empty state — minimum 150 states
U-001.B2: Playwright MCP DOM crawl inventory — every page visited, elements extracted (buttons, inputs, tiles, cards, tabs, links, toggles) with data-testid and text content
U-001.B3: Screenshot inventory — minimum 25 screenshots across all major routes, both org_admin and super_admin perspectives
U-001.B4: Each screenshot has independent visual analysis describing what is visible (produced WITHOUT seeing DOM crawl results)
U-001.B5: Reconciliation document diffs DOM inventory against screenshot visual analysis — every mismatch listed with page, what DOM says, what screenshot shows
U-001.B6: Prior 17 screenshots from E-012 incorporated into screenshot inventory
U-001.B7: Coverage percentage calculated — crawled states vs total enumerated states
U-001.B8: Post-sprint report documents all mismatches found and their significance
entryGates: A1: Previous sprint committed or parked — SKIP (first sprint after harness rebuild)
A2: Worktree clean (no application files modified)
A4: Pre-execution report exists in evidence/U-001/
A5: Pre-exec has ## Objective describing the inventory scope
A6: Pre-exec has ## Test Plan listing Playwright navigation commands
A7: Pre-exec has ## Declared Files (evidence files only — no app code changes)
exitGates: B1: state-enumeration.md exists with >= 150 states — wc -l evidence/U-001/state-enumeration.md
B2: DOM inventory exists — test -f evidence/U-001/dom-inventory.md && wc -l evidence/U-001/dom-inventory.md
B3: Screenshots directory has >= 25 PNG files — ls evidence/U-001/screenshots/*.png | wc -l
B4: Visual analysis exists as separate document — test -f evidence/U-001/visual-analysis.md
B5: Reconciliation diffs DOM vs screenshots — grep -c MISMATCH evidence/U-001/reconciliation.md
B6: Prior screenshots present — ls evidence/U-001/screenshots/ | head -17
B7: Coverage % documented — grep -i coverage evidence/U-001/reconciliation.md
B8: Post-sprint report exists with mismatch summary
B9: Entry gate was approved — grep "ENTRY GATE: APPROVED" evidence/U-001/pre-execution-report.md
sprints.wholeProductFit: First step in QA Resolve Loop — establishes ground truth before any testing or remediation

executionSteps.action: Ghost entry gate — run A-gates from this sprint
Dev Phase 1 — state enumeration (list every route, tab, modal, conditional view, permission gate, empty state)
Ghost verify Phase 1 — state-enumeration.md exists, >= 150 states, organized by route

Dev Phase 2A + 2B PARALLEL — (A) Playwright MCP DOM crawl: visit every enumerated state, extract all elements to dom-inventory.md. (B) Screenshot capture: take screenshot of every major state, write independent visual analysis to visual-analysis.md WITHOUT seeing DOM results
Ghost verify Phase 2 — dom-inventory.md exists with element counts per page, screenshots >= 25, visual-analysis.md exists and does NOT reference dom-inventory
Dev Phase 3 — reconciliation: diff DOM inventory against visual analysis, flag every mismatch (element in DOM but not visible, visible but not in DOM, count differences), calculate coverage %
Ghost verify Phase 3 — reconciliation.md exists, lists specific mismatches with page references, coverage % present
Dev Phase 4 — diff against prior execution (commit 48bdd43) state-enumeration and reconciliation
Ghost exit gate — run all B-gates from this sprint

sprints.name: Gap Analysis — Cross-Reference Inventory vs ACs + Define Remediation Sprints
sprints.source: plan.md — QA Resolve Loop step after U-001
sprints.outcome: Every gap between what exists in the app and what is tested is identified, domain-tagged, and organized into remediation sprints with ACs.
acceptanceCriteria: G-004.B1: Cross-reference document comparing U-001 inventory against existing ACs (P-1 through S-10, SEC series, T series)
G-004.B2: New issues appended to issues.md, each domain-tagged (FE/BE/DT/AU/IN) with severity
G-004.B3: Remediation sprint definitions added to sprints.json with described ACs, gates, and executionSteps
G-004.B4: Test file created covering critical gaps — minimum 5 test cases
G-004.B5: Each new issue references the U-001 evidence that revealed the gap
G-004.B6: Diff against prior gap analysis (commit 48bdd43 issues I-149 through I-158) — document differences
G-004.B7: Post-sprint report with issues summary and remediation sprint summary
entryGates: A1: U-001 exit gate cleared — grep 'EXIT GATE: CLEARED' evidence/U-001/post-sprint-report.md
A4: Pre-execution report exists in evidence/G-004/
A7: U-001 evidence exists and is non-empty — test -d evidence/U-001 && ls evidence/U-001/*.md
exitGates: B1: Cross-reference document exists — test -f evidence/G-004/cross-reference.md
B2: issues.md has new domain-tagged entries — grep 'FE\|BE\|DT\|AU\|IN' issues.md | tail -20
B3: sprints.json has new remediation sprints with described ACs — python3 check
B4: Test file exists with >= 5 test cases — grep -c 'test(' tests/e2e/g004-*.spec.ts
B5: Each new issue references U-001 evidence — grep 'U-001' issues.md
B6: Diff document exists — test -f evidence/G-004/diff-vs-48bdd43.md
B7: Post-sprint report exists with summaries
sprints.wholeProductFit: Identifies all gaps and produces the sprint backlog that drives the rest of the QA cycle

executionSteps.action: Ghost entry gate — run A-gates (including U-001 exit gate check)
Dev Phase 1 — cross-reference U-001 inventory against existing ACs, identify gaps
Ghost verify Phase 1 — cross-reference.md exists, references U-001 evidence
Dev Phase 2 — write new issues to issues.md (domain-tagged), define remediation sprints in sprints.json
Ghost verify Phase 2 — new issues domain-tagged, new sprints have described ACs and gates
Dev Phase 3 — write test file for critical gaps, diff against prior execution (48bdd43)
Ghost verify Phase 3 — test file has >= 5 tests, diff document exists
Ghost exit gate — run all B-gates from this sprint
